definitions.gloss: blood draw, blood sampling, taking blood
definitions.explanation: The medical procedure of drawing blood from a patient, typically from a vein in the arm, for testing or donation purposes.

examples.japanese: {採血|さいけつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{痛|いた}くなかった→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{採血|さいけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had blood drawn during my health checkup.

examples.japanese: {採血|さいけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えて→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was told to refrain from eating before the blood draw.

notes:
USAGE:
A common medical procedure word. Patients encounter this during ⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧ (health checkups), hospital visits, and blood donation. The procedure is performed by a nurse or phlebotomist.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{献血|けんけつ}→献血：16161_kenketsu⟧: blood donation (giving blood voluntarily for others)
- {採血|さいけつ}: blood draw (having blood taken for testing)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {採血|さいけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to draw blood
- {採血|さいけつ}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧: blood draw room
- ⟦{空腹時|くうふくじ}→空腹時：17888_kuufukuji⟧{採血|さいけつ}: fasting blood draw
- {採血|さいけつ}⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: blood test results
